display_title: Shi ni Modori Oujo, Boukun no Senzoku Chef ni Nacchaimashita
mangabaka_title: Shi ni Modori Oujo, Boukun no Senzoku Chef ni Nacchaimashita
native_title: 死に戻り王女、暴君の専属シェフになっちゃいました
romanized_title: Shi ni Modori Oujo, Boukun no Senzoku Chef ni Nacchaimashita
description:
Princess Alina of a fallen kingdom, having endured countless deaths, resolved to finally live a peaceful life. She changed her name to “Lise Kruger” in an enemy nation and lived quietly as a cook. But one day, the boy she saved turned out to be the tyrannical prince who killed her in a past life! She had been cooking to survive, yet he declared, “Only your cooking will do,” unexpectedly making her his personal chef!? A fate that keeps them apart, a healing table, and an inescapable bond. 

A new story of life and love, woven together by “cooking,” begins.

(Source: Piccoma, translated)
